# The Plix Goa

> Luxury private pool villas, boutique resorts, and heritage bungalows in North Goa. Book direct and skip OTA commissions.

## About

The Plix Goa is a hospitality brand offering handpicked luxury stays across five distinct pockets of North Goa: Anjuna, Vagator, Assagao, Morjim, and Candolim. Every property is booked as a whole-unit private sanctuary — the pool, kitchen, and garden are exclusively yours.

## Properties

- **Casa Marina** — 4 BHK private pool villa in Anjuna, up to 8 guests. Floor-to-ceiling glass, panoramic pool views.
- **Casa Moana** — 3 BHK boutique pool villa in Vagator, up to 6 guests. Bespoke interiors, private pool courtyard.
- **Casa Meadows** — 5 BHK grand pool villa in Vagator, up to 10–12 guests. Valley views, wide lawns, concierge service.
- **Harbor Court** — Boutique resort in Vagator, up to 20 guests. Swimming pool, on-site restaurant, minutes from Vagator Beach.
- **The Plix Villa** — 3 BHK luxury private pool villa in Assagao, up to 6 guests. Full-time caretaker, landscaped gardens.
- **Morjim Pride** — Beachfront resort in Morjim, up to 50 guests. Steps from Morjim Beach, pool, on-site dining.
- **Vivenda Chico** — 8 BHK heritage bungalow in Candolim, up to 20 guests. Private pool, sprawling lawns, wedding-friendly.

## Why Book Direct

- Zero booking or platform fees — pay the nightly rate plus taxes, nothing else.
- Guaranteed best rate, straight from the source.
- Free cancellation up to 14 days before check-in with a full refund.
- Whole-property privacy: pool, kitchen, and garden are exclusively yours.

## Locations

- **Anjuna** — Valley views, flea markets, laid-back charm
- **Vagator** — Cliffside villas, sunset beach clubs, Chapora Fort
- **Assagao** — Curated design villas in a serene village setting
- **Morjim** — Turtle beach calm, sea-breeze resorts
- **Candolim** — Heritage estates, lively beach shacks
